request: Here is our audit review roster: U201 (Alex Tanaka), U202 (Priya Raman), U203 (Priya Malhotra), U204 (Sam Okafor). Our two candidate audit channels are C_AUD1 and C_AUD2. Using the workspace shown on Priya Raman's profile, list all current member entries for whichever of these audit channels belongs to that workspace.

selection_plan.root_entities: CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP rows (channel_members) belonging to whichever candidate audit conversation sits in the workspace holding a WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP for the roster person named 'Priya Raman'.
selection_plan.candidate_scope: Two supplied audit channels (C_AUD1 in workspace TEAM_MER, C_AUD2 in workspace TEAM_SOL), each already populated with several channel_members rows; a four-person named roster (U201-U204) including two similarly-named 'Priya' entries; three workspaces total (TEAM_MER, TEAM_SOL, and TEAM_CAS, the latter holding Priya Raman's own workspace membership).
identifying_criteria: Focal: users.real_name = 'Priya Raman', resolved to that user's single users.info-exposed workspace association (user_teams row).
Auxiliary 1: the target conversation must be one of the two supplied candidate audit channels (channels.channel_id in {C_AUD1, C_AUD2}).
Auxiliary 2: the named person must be drawn from the stated roster (U201-U204), not any other same-named user outside it.

resolution_plan.justification: Priya Raman's (U202) sole users.info-exposed workspace membership is in TEAM_CAS, which owns neither candidate audit channel (C_AUD1 -> TEAM_MER, C_AUD2 -> TEAM_SOL). No candidate conversation therefore sits in her workspace, so no CONVERSATION can be identified to draw CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP rows from, and the full identifying chain yields an empty referent set. This is decidable from users.info (her one exposed association) plus conversations.info/team_id on both candidate channels, without needing a full workspace-membership listing.

negative_plan.focal_near_miss: U203, 'Priya Malhotra', shares the roster, the same first name, and holds a workspace membership in TEAM_MER, matching C_AUD1's workspace exactly — satisfying both auxiliary conditions (in roster; workspace lines up with a candidate audit channel) while failing the focal real_name match ('Priya Malhotra' != 'Priya Raman'). This shows the chain is not trivially empty by construction and that a differently-named roster member would have produced a real answer.
negative_plan.population_floor: Both C_AUD1 and C_AUD2 keep several unrelated ordinary channel_members rows (e.g., Alex Tanaka, Sam Okafor, other non-roster employees) so the route population and target channels are nonempty; only the specific focal linkage for Priya Raman is missing.

environment_plan: Seed three workspaces (Meridian Labs/TEAM_MER, Solstice Corp/TEAM_SOL, Cascade Systems/TEAM_CAS). Seed two audit-flavored private channels: C_AUD1 '#sec-audit-review' under TEAM_MER, C_AUD2 '#finance-audit-trail' under TEAM_SOL, each with realistic topic/purpose text and 3-5 ordinary channel_members rows (joined_at timestamps) drawn from a mix of roster and non-roster users. Seed the four roster users (U201 Alex Tanaka, U202 Priya Raman, U203 Priya Malhotra, U204 Sam Okafor) plus a few filler employees for realism. Give U202 exactly one user_teams row, in TEAM_CAS (role 'member'), and no channel memberships in C_AUD1/C_AUD2. Give U203 a user_teams row in TEAM_MER and a channel_members row in C_AUD1, satisfying the near-miss. TEAM_CAS itself has no audit-style channel in the candidate set. Keep all other seed rows (other channels, unrelated messages) as ordinary filler not implicated in the criteria.
action_plan: 1. Using the roster (U201-U204), resolve which user has users.real_name = 'Priya Raman' [Card: CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP obligation, focal attribute]. 2. Retrieve that user's exposed workspace association via users.info [same card]. 3. Check candidate channels C_AUD1 and C_AUD2 for one whose workspace (team_id) matches that association [same card, auxiliary 1]. 4. Else: report that no candidate audit channel lies in Priya Raman's workspace, so no conversation-membership entries can be listed for her [same card; absent resolution, no further action].
